items.q: Oh, I loved him! Fletcher Henderson? We've got to be careful, these people are big people. The Jewish people are very big people. Just like a four-star general coming on the scene and you're a little corporal back there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Same time, have the same ways. And if you don't know me, I'm with you but I'm away from you. See, so (inaudible). I didn't penetrate. I know when I penetrate. See, I didn't penetrate. So that's what I -- I never penetrate (inaudible). But that is me. I hear the music that he's -- I heard it perfectly. (I understand/ Because sometimes I have things in my own mind I'm trying to find my way out of. So that is what happened.
Well now, during that period, how did Fletcher Hendersom come off in person?

Oh, I loved him! Fletcher Henderson? We've got to be careful, these people are big people. The Jewish people are very big people. Just like a four-star general coming on the scene and you're a little corporal back there. What are you doing?
